title: Compact-fixed-locus definitions and pole obstructions for noncompact elliptic genera
exact_target: Find hypotheses and conventions that give a well-defined elliptic genus for noncompact Calabi–Yau spaces.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002506 (AIM-PHYSICS-0014). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Gromov-Witten invariants and number theory, source item 3.1.

status_qualification: The source does not select an equivariant, analytic, compact-support or regularized definition. Any sufficient construction must be distinguished from a full characterization of when a definition exists. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
